title: Tre Quartetti per due Violini, Viola e Basso, composti del Sig. Luigi Boccherini — Opera 54, 1796
discrepancy: The Gerard span 250-255 comes from the prior-pass filename ('Opus 54 Numbers 1-6'), but the title page reads 'Tre Quartetti' -- three, not six. Sampled pages are single-line part music throughout, so this volume is a part-book, not a score. The count is unresolved.
established_by: Official scan commissioned from the Library of Congress. Title page reads 'Opera 54 ... 1796 ... Tre Quartetti Per due Violini, Viola e Basso Composti del Sig. Luigi Boccherini ... Violino Primo'. No GerB number in the 250-255 range appears anywhere in the harvested RISM records, so this set sits outside the RISM corpus this project indexes. Filed 2026-09-28.
arrived_as_note: Supplied as a finished PDF, not collated here from page images, so there are no filenames whose meaning could be lost. `page_index` does not apply.
